confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Marrakech price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are more reliable than the alcohol and 3-star hotel anchors. Alcohol is limited and heavily taxed, so beer, cocktail and wine_glass are the least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about twice a draught beer, wine glass about 1.4 times) because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. Hotel and private-room prices vary widely by area and season and could be off by 20 to 30 percent.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparator city. Regional basis: other mid-sized North African tourist cities such as Fes and Tangier, adjusted upward for Marrakech's tourist-zone restaurant and riad pricing, with accommodation set to typical July summer rates.
